open.question: What will the Survey make of the unnamed peak it grew over the small bench's exception?
The sector's lights now rest on Aster's house and on twelve whitened shelves; what happens when that column can no longer be paid?

closed.question: Will Kesh leave the small bench out of the arrival node, as Aster asked him to?
closed.resolution: Kesh filed the small bench's two hundred and seventeen books as unsorted and unresolved, accepted the Survey's rating penalty, and the bench's print stayed black.

promises.promise: The small bench stays unsorted for as long as Kesh holds the relief table, whatever the Survey's rating says.

deferred_answers.question: Who signed the Earth-Library sector's payer column before Aster's house, and why is the first line under the name in no hand Dorel has been trained on?
deferred_answers.reason: The name is the load-bearing fact of the book; answering it in the first episode would spend the whole column before the reader has seen what the column costs.
